selection_rule: Candidate subjects and canonical answers are frozen before Bazel source acquisition. Candidates are evaluated in listed rank order. The first four eligible candidates fill bpd-bazel-ds-01..04. Eligibility requires four unique current Bazel-authored authoritative source files, one required source per producer, exact answer support, and no exact source-byte reuse with any previously selected confirmatory case. A candidate may be rejected only for a source-integrity or frozen-design eligibility failure; treatment or evaluator outcomes may not be observed or used.
